items.excerpt: The human remains found in East Greenbush have to undergo additional testing to determine who it is. Also, a Fort Ann man has been arrested after allegedly causing a multi-car crash in Moreau. These stories, and more, are in your five things to know, sponsored by the Lia Auto Group.

items.headline: Union, RPI football set for 76th edition of Dutchman Shoes Trophy Game
items.excerpt: The newest chapter in the oldest college football rivalry in New York State will be written this weekend, as Union and RPI are set to square off on the gridiron once again in a battle for the Dutchman Shoes Trophy.

items.excerpt: Demonstrators started the night at the Columbia County Office Building by holding a rally before the Board of Supervisors meeting resisting Flock cameras. items.headline: Colonie EMS secures $4M to improve care across nine counties
items.excerpt: The Town of Colonie Emergency Medical Services Department has secured $4 million to advance lifesaving emergency care across nine counties. items.headline: Firefighters dig through rubble after NYC building collapse kills 2 and traps people in wreckage
items.excerpt: Firefighters dug through the rubble of a three-story building in Brooklyn after it collapsed at the edge of a construction site Wednesday afternoon, killing at least two people and trapping others beneath the wreckage.

items.headline: 40th annual Victorian Streetwalk to bring timeless holiday cheer to Saratoga Springs
items.excerpt: Take a step back in time while celebrating the timeless charm of downtown Saratoga Springs during the holiday season at the annual Victorian Streetwalk. Returning for its 40th year, the festive evening will take place on Thursday, December 3, from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m.
